text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the promised deadline with Tamamo Cross has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Our plan so far was to watch over her physical growth until the spring of the Classic year, but—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nom, chomp... I can still eat more...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite having a small appetite,
Tamamo Cross ate as much as she could, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadada!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Spurt time right here!!
I've still got plenty left in the tank!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, hah! Hmph, hah!
This much ain't nothin' to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her body was steadily transforming. At the very least, she had built up the baseline strength required of an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
How's that, Trainer! My room for growth
was something seriously impressive, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We can really do it this year, right?!
That race I've always dreamed of—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "The heck?! I go there all the time! Not that, you meant the 'Classic Triple Crown', right?!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not the type to get blinded by shiny things right in front of me.
I ain't gonna say the Triple Crown is just a dream, either.
But still..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I want something tangible to show for it. Even the little ones back home know what the Triple Crown is, after all."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna tell her...
"Sis, I won the Triple Crown!"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand how you feel.
However..."
choice_data_list: I'm not sure we can aim that high.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer tellin' me... my body's
still not good enough?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Even after I begged you this much, it's still no good?
C'mon? Pretty please? Pretty please with a cherry on top?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It would be easy to just nod along,
but it's meaningless if it ends up throwing Tamamo Cross's future away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Depending on her condition, we could enter her in the Classic Triple Crown. But we can't take the risk of targeting a GⅠ that's certain to be a rough, full-gate battle.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Then until when?! How long do I gotta be patient
until I can aim for the big races?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Factoring in current growth and making a calm, objective prediction...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—!?
So you're tellin' me I gotta wait through the Classic year?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...All right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, Tamamo Cross accepted it readily.
However, her eyes were brimming
with frustration...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So this is Tracen Academy, huh... Umamusume boasting their speed from all over the country, all gathered together...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Every one of 'em's been gettin' special trainin' since they were kids.
They ain't like me, who couldn't attend anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Making it work in the middle of nowhere with total strangers really is tough..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Still, don't you dare underestimate me!
I'm used to rock bottom! Besides—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I ain't the only one struggling out here in the middle of nowhere. There are others, too..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Someone who came from the countryside knowing nothing,
yet still keeps looking up toward the top.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I won't lose! Not to her, not to the world, and not to myself!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Think of this frustration as... an investment. Let's stash it away now so we can blow the lid off next year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer. I'm counting on you for our upcoming strategy.
A strategy so I can push forward without stumbling!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the strategy they came up with was—to run in multiple graded races
and rack up real results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she gets swallowed by the pack and wears down
due to her small, frail build... this strategy allows us
to make up for it with race volume.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see... As long as I hang in there on sheer guts,
I reckon I can snag a top-three finish or so.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Then let's go with this.
In exchange, no slip-ups allowed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having gained Tamamo Cross's approval,
our course of action was set.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Dad?
Yeah, things are goin' great over here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Like a true Naniwa merchant, I figured I'd stick to the safe bets.
Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dunno if I'll have any big news this year, but
next year... I'm definitely runnin' in it.
In that race Dad loves so much.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So, how are things on your end?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Did something happen to... Ma? Huh, it's nothin' serious? Well, alright then, that's fine...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"When she looks tired, be gentle with her.
Then just relax together and watch some TV."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If it's a graded race, it'll be on TV, right?
Hehe, in that sense, it's a great goal.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Make sure ya don't push yerself too hard, okay?
I'll be takin' it easy too. See ya around.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"'Finish 3rd or better in a Graded race 4 times.'
Let's tick them off cleanly and aim for the top."
